method law
results are regrouped or operations reordered

an arbitrary operator needs its own law preserving the outer predicate; invalid intermediate joins defeat the rewrite premise; reordering needs effect independence; sequence is not automatically conjunction of all historical stages; absent stages retain observed performance and extent

method law
interpretable composite has no authenticated applicable falsification
satisfaction requires established coverage, authentic results and material joins; an empty list needs proof that the required set is empty

private context is discarded or process resumes
full history replay is not universal; every previous activation transcript is unnecessary when sufficient sources survive
method law
a task-based Executive arrangement is selected
work outside current attention stays in workspace; adaptive reassignment retains obligations, effects, authority and assurance; optimality is evidence-relative
method law
the foundational relationship is claimed
the selected methodology interpretation proves no universal executor or world completeness
method law
a decision or stop is reported
lawful rejection or stopping can satisfy its decision predicate while candidate fitness or product completion remains undecided
method law
observations combine over a declared composite effect scope

timestamps alone grant no supersession; retain all observations and irreversible external parts; deployment then rollback is reverted, reapplication completed; normalized join is unknown-dominant, completed mixed with reverted/not_started is partial, reverted with only reverted/not_started/not_requested is reverted, homogeneous completion or nonstart ignores not_requested; not_requested requires an established effect-free scope under the supported operating model, not merely no request
method law
an effect is relevant to the operation

unknown acknowledgment is not not_started; dispatch is not effect start; all material possibly affected parts, requested or unintended, belong to the supported boundary; no request alone proves no effect; an unrequested possible part observed not begun contributes not_requested with its evidence, while a requested nonstart remains not_started; known rollback is reverted only within its evidenced boundary; partial has known completed and known unexecuted or reverted parts; unknown remainder stays unknown

method law
a logical operator combines results

authentic truth or falsity decides the outer predicate; otherwise only material deciding dependencies enter invalid_basis then out_of_frame then indeterminate; retain failed leaves and do not pass negation, disjunction or fallback off as conjunction
method law
performance of the named evaluation is reported
retain extent, interruption and conclusion separately; absent slots remain coverage rather than fabricated judgments; admission or dispatch is not downstream undertaking
method law

purpose, identity, compatibility and assurance are extra premises; finite capacity does not derive them
method law

thirteen syntactically possible pairs are not thirteen automatically admissible results; preserve extent, interruption, conclusion and every effect coordinate; absent return proves neither nonperformance nor a performed inconclusive evaluation

method law
domain outcome is reported

missing required reason is not deciding support; separately admissible counterevidence or scope/basis diagnosis still decides that same predicate under the legal pairs without inventing execution; unobserved requested or material possible unintended effects remain unknown
method law
a result is reported
every result projection retains material performance/effect coordinates; sufficient resolvable references are permitted without a universal serialization or extra carrier
method law
a stored result is reused
preserve demonstrably independent work; widen inspection when independence is unproved; stored green status alone is not validity
method law

partial persistent progress implies no universal idempotence; logs have only their declared domain role
method law

observations do not silently replace a frozen basis or rewrite governing requirements; reality and intended constraints remain distinct
